title: 15. Does My Teacher Dislike Me?
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Toto came home from preschool with a big pout. Stomping both feet, Toto plopped onto Grandma's lap. Grandma, I think my teacher only dislikes me. Toto sniffled, almost crying.
Grandma gently patted Toto's back. Oh, you feel very upset. But is that really what happened? Yes! It really is! Toto puffed up those cheeks. Tell me one thing at a time, then. I'll listen to it all.
Toto shared the first complaint. Today the teacher only scolded me! Not Kongi, just me! Toto stamped both feet. That means the teacher dislikes only me. It's so unfair!
Grandma asked gently, What happened just before that? Toto thought carefully. Oh, right. Toto had pushed Kongi first. Um, I pushed first. Toto's cheeks turned pink.
Toto shared the second complaint. But still! Today only Bori got a praise sticker. I didn't get any! Toto pouted. See? I was left out again. That's mean!
Grandma smiled. Really? Shall we look in your pocket? Toto rummaged around. What's this? Two shiny star stickers! Oh, I got some, too. The teacher had been fair to everyone.
Toto shared the last complaint. But still! I raised my hand, and the teacher didn't choose me! Toto held an arm high in the air. See? I was left out again!

Grandma tilted her head. Where were you sitting then? Um, right at the back, hidden behind Bori. Toto answered quietly. Oh, the teacher probably couldn't see your hand! Oh. It wasn't because the teacher disliked Toto.

Toto's eyes grew round. Then the teacher wasn't picking on me? Grandma gently tapped Toto's nose. Of course not! If you decide someone dislikes you before looking carefully, you can miss all the kind things they do. Toto smiled shyly.

The next morning, Toto opened the classroom door wide. Good morning, Teacher! Teacher Sheep smiled brightly and offered a warm welcome. When we look at things a new way, the world can look different. My teacher didn't dislike me after all!
